items.docs: Retrieves a paginated list of execution runs for a specific workflow. Each run represents a single execution of the workflow and includes status, timing, and output information.

params.name: workflowId

items.docs: Triggers an execution run of the specified workflow. The workflow is executed asynchronously and the run status can be monitored using the run details endpoint. Input parameters can be provided to configure the execution context.

items.docs: Retrieves the details and current status of a specific workflow run, including step-level progress, timing information, any errors encountered, and output references.

items.docs: Cancels a pending or running workflow execution. The cancellation is asynchronous and the run status will transition to cancelled once all active steps have stopped processing.
